   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Sep 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _K.loves20_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "So far Notion has been great, my number 1 go to for note taking among other things. But now the app has been more of nuisance than anything because it has several glitches now. For one, whenever I highlight a paragraph and try applying italic, or bold to it, it only applies to the first word and only allows me to edit that first word. Another recent development being that whenever I try highlighting a text to put it in a different color, by the time I go to the color menu the entire thing becomes deselected and uncolorable. Please fix this."
            2. _BlA387532_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
            3. _WaasSun_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "It just keep pulling everything up. Unusable on Mac."
